1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __a machine-readable tag that is not disclosed in Maxell Corp. of America as of April 29, 2004__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __and wherein the embedded MTP comprises a specific identifier or data structure not taught by Maxell__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, __and wherein the embedding configuration includes a protective layer between the MTP and the test tube material__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term storage of biological samples at temperatures below -20°C__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the polypropylene or acetal polymer is selected to maintain structural integrity and MTP readability at cryogenic temperatures of -20°C or below__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube__.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the material is selected to withstand cryogenic storage conditions while maintaining MTP readability__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and wherein the embedding maintains the structural integrity of the test tube during cryogenic storage__.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, __and wherein the embedding configuration is optimized for automated reading at cryogenic temperatures__.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and wherein the embedding is configured to facilitate automated sample tracking and retrieval__.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, __and wherein the assembly is compatible with automated laboratory handling systems__.
